tickets.text: The ticket buys the break at the high (trigger close_above:high_52w_close); Elder buys the pullback under a rising average, not the plateau (C6, C10). Permission is on, W above EMA9 with 9>21, but permission is a gate, not a buy reason (C1). Clears if the trigger reads in_zone:ma_20 on D with elder 7 or more.

Trend leg unverified: W swing LH/LL against D HH/HL and elder_pattern INTERRUPTED means the trend leg failed (C9, C22). Trigger close_above:high_52w_close is a breakout buy, not my entry. Clears when elder_pattern leaves INTERRUPTED, W swing turns HH/HL, and the trigger is in_zone:ma_20 on D.

D swing LH but HL and elder_pattern INTERRUPTED, price 1.4% under the 20-day high: no dip to buy, so I stand aside (C22). A close above the 52-week closing high is a chase, not Elder's entry. Clears when elder_pattern leaves INTERRUPTED, D prints HH/HL, and the trigger is in_zone:ma_20 on D.

Trigger h1_close_above:pivot_high buys an hourly break on strength; D swing LH/LL and mp 48.0 are soft. Elder buys the dip under the average, not the break (C6, C10). Permission held is a gate only (C1). Clears if the trigger reads in_zone:ma_20 on D with permission held (elder 7 or more).

W and D HH/HL is sound, but trigger close_above:high_52w_close chases the new high with H1 at 96% of range. My entry is the dip to the 20-day average (C6, C10), not the break. Clears if the trigger reads in_zone:ma_20 on D with elder 7 or more.

ext_atr20 2.41 and an elder_5d plateau with no 6-or-less bar: that is C24 (unsourced), not a transition. A 52-week-high close chases above value; a pinned reading is summer, not Elder's buying season (C20). Clears when a transition bar prints and the trigger is in_zone:ma_20 on D.

Trigger close_above:high_52w_close buys the high; H1 HH but LL is soft. W and D HH/HL with blue held permits (C3), but permission is not a reason to buy; Elder's entry is the dip to the average, not the breakout (C6, C10). Clears if the trigger reads in_zone:ma_20 on D with elder 7 or more.

ext_atr20 2.38 and an elder_5d plateau with no 6-or-less bar (C24, unsourced); a 52-week-high close chases above value (C11). Pinned strength is summer, not Elder's buying season (C20). Clears if the trigger reads in_zone:ma_20 on D after a pullback transition, with no breakout entry.
